scope: Theorem 1.2 of the manuscript “A uniformly discrete counterexample to bounded approximation in Lipschitz-free spaces” (preprints/Failure-of-Bounded-Approximation-in-a-Lipschitz-Free-Space-over-a-Uniformly-Discrete-Metric-Space-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 330 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 aa4ce066ba72c12f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For each integer p ≥ 1, there are a bounded countably infinite pointed metric space (Mp, dp, o) and a finite set Ap ⊆ Mp containing o such that dp(x, y) ≥ 1 (x ̸= y), diam Mp ≤ Bp := 300p2 + 150p + 5, and every bounded finite-rank linear operator T0 : F(Mp) → F(Mp) with ∥T0∥ ≤ p satisfies max a∈Ap ∥T0δa − δa∥ ≥ 1 2 .
